blocks: Your home could be the set
What makes a home interesting?
Character and practicality, not polish.

Interiors with personality, architecture that could pass for somewhere else, a driveway with room for a van. None of these guarantees interest; together they are what the people who find locations describe looking for.
What could your home be used for?
Not only film.
Most Irish demand is not feature film. These are the kinds of production the page’s sources describe.
Advertising and content
The busiest end of the Irish market: shoots for advertising agencies and content creators, often a smaller crew for a day.
Advertising and content The busiest end of the Irish market: shoots for advertising agencies and content creators, often a smaller crew for a day. Read more
Television
Drama and series, including shows set in the UK or America, where an ordinary Irish house can stand in for a house somewhere else.

04 Suitability and access
Parking, a way in for equipment, dry storage, power and toilets usually decide it, more than how the house looks.

05 Scheduling
From an afternoon to twelve weeks in one Irish example, including set-up and removal. You say when the property is not available.

06 Agreements and permissions
Changes are agreed line by line, rooms can be put out of bounds, and you sign a contract. Tenants and joint owners should settle authorisation first.
